nodes.title: Fix the MembersPage stats-strip test: page stuck on table.loading when 'stat-total' is queried (MembersPage.test.tsx:447)
nodes.rootCause:
Frontend job red with exactly ONE assertion failure out of 3797 (3784 passed, 12 skipped). src/__tests__/MembersPage.test.tsx > 'global all-fields search (Option 1)' > 'drives the stats strip (total stays full, filtered follows the search)' at line 447 does `expect(screen.getByTestId('stat-total')).toHaveTextContent('3')`, but TestingLibraryElementError: 'Unable to find an element by: [data-testid=stat-total]'. The rendered DOM shows the page is STILL on its loading state: `

table.loading

` + `` spinner, and neither the stats strip nor the table body has rendered. So the data-loading promise had not resolved (rows + stats not yet painted) at the moment the assertion ran. The test queries stat-total synchronously / without first awaiting the rows to settle (other tests in the same file use a `waitForRows()` helper before asserting; this case appears to assert before/without that settle). This is a data-loading-hook timing regression surfaced one cycle behind the 2026-10-15 code-quality arc, whose task 6 split MembersPage.tsx (1161 LOC) and EXTRACTED the data-loading hooks. MembersPage is the documented historical red zone (regressed 09-26; the 09-29 lesson warns it recurs one cycle behind every Members UI refactor). Non-deterministic flake class (async settle race), not a product-logic bug: 3784 other tests incl. the full member-analytics-pivot-filter-operators feature set are green. Fix: await the rows/stats to settle before querying stat-total (reuse the file's waitForRows()/waitFor pattern), or ensure the extracted data-loading hook flushes its initial fetch deterministically under the test's fake data. NOT a feature regression from PR #115 (analytics filters) — that touched analytics files, not MembersPage.
